event_description: User created a new todo item. Key conversion event indicating active engagement with the app.
User marked a todo as complete. Indicates successful task completion and app value delivery.
User unmarked a completed todo (set back to active). Could indicate task reconsideration.
User deleted a todo item. Could indicate task abandonment or cleanup behavior.
Failed to create a todo due to an error. Error tracking for monitoring app reliability.
Failed to update a todo due to an error. Error tracking for monitoring app reliability.
Failed to delete a todo due to an error. Error tracking for monitoring app reliability.
Failed to fetch todos on page load. Critical error affecting user experience.
User navigated to the about page. Top of funnel event for understanding user interest in the product.
Server-side error when creating a todo. Backend error monitoring.
Validation error when creating or updating a todo. Indicates potential UX issues.
Server-side error when updating a todo. Backend error monitoring.
Server-side error when deleting a todo. Backend error monitoring.
Attempted to access a todo that doesn't exist. Could indicate data sync issues.
